title: Allocate Stock
readerIntent: Commit reserved stock to a fulfillment intent safely.
priorKnowledge: Know reservation, source, quantity/unit, order/fulfillment identity, and concurrency policy.
summary: Allocation atomically validates reservation and available balance, records fulfillment ownership, and prevents duplicate consumption.

sections.heading: Contract
items: Tenant, product/variant, warehouse/pool, reservation, fulfillment reference, quantity/unit, idempotency key, expiry, and revision.
Reject missing/expired reservation, unit mismatch, insufficient balance, duplicate/conflicting idempotency, wrong tenant, and stale revision.
Publish safe outcome and invalidate affected availability only after commit.
